checks.detail: RI-STL01 §2's five worked rows, measured by the critic's own instrument against the running world: 1.0167 / 3.95 / 8.45 / 26.65 / 26.65 s against the item's 1.03 / 3.94 / 8.5 / 26.7 / 26.7 s. Worst error 1.29%. Both clamps fire (V=1.30 row 1, V=0.05 rows 4 and 5). Round 1 measured 0.500 s for every row.

RI-MTH07 §B on the pair the item's §C used: V 1.30 -> 0.050, predicted 1.03 -> 26.7 s, observed 1.0167 -> 26.65 s, coupling |26.65-1.0167| / |26.7-1.03| = 0.9986. Round 1 was 0.00. Null control at 30 m: alert 0.0000 over 600 f.

The brief's converse test. Each term of V and each geometric term varied ALONE, measured fill compared against 150·V·(1−d/R)·cone: L (0.04/0.35/1.00), M (still/walk/sprint), S (5/100), E (light/medium/heavy/overloaded), A (cover), d (2 / 8 / 14 / 15.9 m -> 44.28 / 25.30 / 6.33 / 0.316 per s, ratio 0.5001 constant) and bearing (0 / 40 / 57 / 70 / 170 deg). Distance is a separate live term, not folded into V. Bearing 57 deg fills at 3.3589/s against 3.36 predicted (the 0.35 peripheral scale) and holds at exactly 70. Bearing 70 and 170 fill 0.0000 — the archetype's own 120 deg statblock cone correctly governs over detection.json's 200 deg peripheral arc.

The critic derived gamma = 1.36 independently from the item's own table before finding it already filed. RI-STL01 §2 states L^0.7 and publishes five rows that 0.7 cannot produce; row 4 is annotated '(clamped)' and is 0.0733 at 0.7, so the item's own annotation is false at its own stated exponent. The build is right and the item is wrong. AMENDMENT-W1-15-01 §1 accepted.

§4's LEFT column reproduces exactly: sprint 36.309 m against 36.2, walk 15.55 against 15.5, crouch 6.48 against 6.5. Its RIGHT column does not and cannot: the item's figures are a flat 0.393-0.400 of r_base while E_sound(light) x S_sound(100) x surface(mud) = 0.75 x 0.50 x 0.70 = 0.2625, giving 3.675 / 1.575 / 0.656 against the item's 5.5 / 2.4 / 1.0. The build implements the stated formula. THIS IS A THIRD ARITHMETIC DEFECT IN RI-STL01 AND NEITHER ROUND FILED IT.

An entity that cannot see the player: r_eff 36.309 m -> AGGRO at 1.633 s on channel `hearing` at 20 m; r_eff 0.656 m -> alert 0.0000 over 600 f at the same 20 m; `still` (r_base 0) -> 0.0000 at 3 m behind. At 1.0 m behind a stationary enemy the discriminator is exact: crouch-move r_eff 0.656 m is silent, walk r_eff 1.575 m is heard and reaches AGGRO.

One box occluder between the chest node and the eye node, cast against sim.cell plus the stealth occluder cell: open -> AGGRO; walled -> alert 0.0000, IDLE, los false, losBetween().clear false. The two rows are otherwise identical.

coverAt() in the open field 0/12 probes blocked, A = 1.00; in a three-walled alcove 11/12 blocked, A = 0.80, V 0.3373 -> 0.2699, in_cover_source `derived_from_geometry`. Round 1 reached A = 0.80 only by a critic passing inCover: true.

3,600 f@60 at 1.0 m directly behind a stationary enemy, still / unlit / Sneak 100 / light: peak alert 0.0000, state IDLE throughout. The discriminator the builder did not run: the SAME position with the enemy turned round fills at 7.0313/s. Round 1 aggro'd in 30 frames.

AGGRO, then the player leaves. SEARCH entered at frame 360 = 6.000 s (RI-AI01 T25), ran to frame 1080 = exactly 12.000 s, walked at 2.04 m/s peak over 720 sampled frames toward the LKP at (0,0,0). S-3 raised the ally 11.66 m away to alert 45 with alert_hop 1 and did not chain. S-4 set the zone baseline to 25 and it is in saveState().crime.zones with baseline_until_f 11999.

`plan: []` and `visited: []` in 4 of 4 placements, including volumes placed behind the searcher, beyond the LKP, and beside the searcher. plausibleSet() vetoes any volume whose LKP-to-volume segment crosses the searcher's own cone, and the searcher is by construction looking AT the LKP, which sits at bearing 0 from it — so every sampled point near the LKP end of every segment is inside the cone. RI-STL01 §7 S-1's headline behaviour, 'it checks WHERE YOU COULD HAVE GONE, not random points', never runs. The search is a walk to the LKP followed by a radial sweep.

Four states with a real hearing channel: a civilian 2 m away and facing AWAY reaches CHALLENGE at suspicion 70 on channel `hearing` under a 36.309 m sound radius, and is held at the CHALLENGE ceiling rather than reaching ALARM; the crouch control at r_eff 0.656 m stays CALM at 0.00. The CHALLENGE off-ramp survives.
getStealthState().hud_elements = 0 in every run recorded in every artifact here.

§9 requires 13 overworld routes, 8 Souls-loop dungeons and 82 caves. None exists — the province is owned by W1-01/W1-03/W1-12. Scored 0 fail-closed, not credited, and recorded as a cross-piece debt. This is the axis that carries the item's min.

§9's SNEAK-QUESTS floor is 22 quests carrying a sneak resolution; the shipped tree has 7, and RI-STL01's own 0-band is '< 10'. Under AMENDMENT-W1-15-01 §6's ratio reading (>= 12% of the shipped tree) 7/33 = 21.2% passes — but the amendment's own supporting table quotes 13 quests / 39.4% / VERB-SPREAD 24.7%, and none of those three figures is true at HEAD.

checks.detail: Round 1's headline failure, closed. ZERO addWitness() calls anywhere in this probe. takeObject() on a placed object with a civilian 3 m away derives observed_by ['cw'] with observed_by_source 'derived_from_the_world', creates crime 1, witness cw identified, and a pending report — and witness_checks explains the guard's exclusion in words ('120.0 m beyond 1.4 x R (25.2 m)').

Two controls, both clean. (a) The same theft with nobody in the world: crime null, witnesses [], bounty 0 after 3,600 further frames. (b) The same theft with a civilian 3 m away who is turned AWAY and behind an occluder: civ_state CALM, crime null, bounty 0 after 3,600 frames. The predicate is reading the world, not a flag.

run_to_guard at 120 m: latency 2,065 f, bounty 21 g landing at 34.43 s against the item's 35.3 s (2.5%). A guard at 20 m is itself a witness and the guard_witness route lands in 1 frame. bribeWitness(0) at 42 g (2x the 21 g quote) -> bounty 0 after 3,600 frames.
arrestTopics() at bounty 3000 returns all three answers, and the refusal text names the shortfall: "You're 2600 gold short, and I can count."

RI-MTH07 pair on the bounty: bounty 0 -> guard_band event band 0 / behaviour none, and the guard entity sits at alert 4.82 SUSPICIOUS on channel `sight`; bounty 3000 -> band 3 / attack_on_sight / weapon_drawn true / parley `surrender`, and the SAME entity is at alert 100 on channel `bounty`. Coupling 1. This is a genuine AR-3 crossing: a world ledger reaching into the fight.

guard_legion declares ai 'hold_ground', and combat/enemy.js runs a scripted action only when stat.ai === 'scripted'. An AGGRO guard_legion held at 2.0 m for 900 frames deals 0 damage, emits no HIT, and never leaves REPOSITION. RI-CRM01 §4's band 3 is the string 'attack_on_sight' with no attack behind it.

guard_legion's parley declares gold_price 0 with base_disposition 35, and combat/parley.js's GOLD ground passes on gold >= price AND disposition >= 20. Measured: an aggro'd band-3 guard at 3 m YIELDS at full HP (520/520) on one `interact` press, with the player's purse at 0, stamina 120 -> 120, imperial bounty 3000 -> 3000 and jail null. The 17-crime schedule, the three arrest answers and the jail ledger are all correct and all discardable by one button. The mechanism is right — inf_trash (gold_price 180) REFUSES cold and ACCEPTS only after learnTopic('the-drowned-ford') — so it is the datum that is wrong.

sim/step.js runs the stealth subsystem unconditionally between the fight and the camera, with no `if (!inCombat)` gate; measured, the guard-band transition and the entity aggro both fire while a combat body is present and hostile.
Bounty, the stolen registry and the S-4 zone memory all appear in saveState().crime and survive a round trip with identical hashes.

reference_items.why_not_ten: The guard ladder resolves to a guard that cannot attack and a surrender that costs nothing and clears nothing, so every other axis in this item — the schedule, the report chain, the arrest, the jail — is reachable but not binding.
reference_items.path_to_ten: Set guard_legion.parley.gold_price to the live imperial bounty (or a fixed >= 200 g) and require disposition >= 40 as the yield ground already does; route an accepted guard surrender into arrestTopics()/answerArrest() so the three answers fire and the bounty is paid, served or refused; and give guard_legion an AI that swings (ai 'scripted' with a scenario, or W1-12's behaviour once it lands).

NAME, FACTION, GOLD and YIELD are all implemented as deterministic threshold tests with no die, and NAME demonstrably works: inf_trash cold -> refused; the same fight after learnTopic('the-drowned-ford') -> YIELDED. But ctx.world.gold is wired to nothing — getCombatState().world_knowledge.gold reads 0 with 400 g in getStealthState() and 405 g in progression after a fence sale — so the GOLD ground is unusable when priced and unconditional when priced 0. There are at least four gold accumulators in this build (sim.stealth.p.gold, sim.progression.gold, engine.magic.gold, ctx.world.gold) against seam S15's 'gold is the only currency'.

3 of 14 enemy statblocks carry a parley. cst_sap_speaker is a CASTER — a speaking thing — with parley null, which S13 calls a defect; it belongs to W1-09/W1-14 rather than here, and is recorded as a cross-piece observation. The 27/27 census this item asks for has no roster to run against.
The race/faction law factor does enter the threshold: imperial race_law 1.35 gives arrest_at 405 and attack_at 1620 off a base of 300. The 15-band, >= 3x spread census is not run here.
No camps exist. Scored 0 fail-closed.

checks.detail: 27.3% at HEAD against a 40% hard-fail cap, measured live by H.questVerbCensus() and independently recomputed from game/data/quests/*.json. Round 1 was 42.1% and was a hard fail. This is a real closure.

The builder reports 'sneak 6 -> 13 quests, steal 3 -> 8, VERB-SPREAD 24.7%'. Those three figures are exactly reproducible at 4a5f13f^ and none is reproducible at HEAD (7 / 5 / 27.3%). Commit 4a5f13f — the commit whose own message claims them — touched only game/data/quests/magic-utility.json, net -179/+5, and its diff DELETES six `sneak` and three `steal` resolutions by id (q_mag_03__sneak, q_mag_05__steal, q_mag_11__sneak, q_mag_13__steal, mag_the_hollow_count__sneak, q_mag_16__sneak, mag_the_far_exit__sneak, q_mag_21__sneak, q_mag_24__steal). Only 5 `added_by: W1-15-r2` markers survive, all in blackmarsh-*.json. Nine of the twelve routes were destroyed by a co-committed regeneration of W1-14's generated quest file before the commit landed.

§C minimums against HEAD: persuade+intimidate 12 vs 12 (met); bribe 8 vs 4; sneak 10 vs 7; steal 10 vs 5; lore_knowledge 10 vs 6. One of five verbs at its minimum, which is below even the item's 7-8 band ('four of five verbs at minimum'). No verb is at 0, so the hard fail does not fire.

questVerbCensus() returns pacifist_all_pct 100 with meaningful: false and the denominator attached, and the note says in as many words that quoting it as a pass is what the round-1 verdict refused. That is the right behaviour for a metric with n = 33.
Quest progression does not exist at this commit. Scored 0 fail-closed for that axis.

takeObject's observedBy and setStealthState's inCover both still accept injected world facts, and both now demonstrate the derived path and flag which was used (observed_by_source, in_cover_source, inCoverForced). pickpocketBegin() still requires {dist, bearingDeg, targetCivState, moving, crouched} to be supplied and there is no world-driven path to it — the critic could not reach a pickpocket by placing an NPC and standing behind it. That is the axis's 6 floor, not its 10.

One model remains effectively orphaned by geometry rather than by wiring: search.js::plausibleSet() is called on every search and returns [] every time, so Search.plan and Search.visited are dead fields in the trace. A model whose consumer always receives the empty set is the same thing from the player's chair.

reference_items.why_not_ten: pickpocketBegin() is still only reachable by hand-feeding the engine the geometry it should observe, and plausibleSet() delivers an empty set on every call.
reference_items.path_to_ten: Give pickpocketBegin() a no-argument form that derives dist, bearing, motion and target state from the nearest spawned NPC, and assert the same eligibility result from both paths; fix plausibleSet() so a search with three volumes within 8 m of the LKP produces a non-empty plan.

blind_comparisons.not_possible_reason: This piece declares blind_pair: no on every reference item it owns, and the axis is not-visual. There is no reference artifact to pair a stealth trace against.

checks.detail: The detection model imports no RNG and is a continuous deterministic function of frame state; the ward-collar moved rng.draws by 0 across a complete open; the parley resolves by deterministic threshold tests. The only draw this piece makes is the pickpocket notice check, which is outside the fight and is seam S21's explicitly preserved die (1 draw per attempt, measured 60/60).

isStealthOpener() returns a boolean and nothing else; there is no number in its return type for a damage formula to multiply by. Sneak enters exactly once, as a >= comparison against an authored integer.

Fill rate is 150·V·(1−d/R)·cone with the archetype's own radius and cone; no term reads the player's level. The rear arc and the statblock cone both fill 0.0000, so the meter is not a proximity check.
getStealthState().hud_elements = 0 in every run in every artifact here. RI-STL01 §3's only permitted feedback is diegetic and there is no visibility bar, eye icon or hidden/detected word.
The report chain surfaces as latency and a bounty delta; the search surfaces as a walking entity and a zone baseline. Nothing in this piece emits a marker or a waypoint.

Bribes (42 g), fence sales (5 g) and parley prices are all gold. No soul-currency purchase exists in this piece. But see RI-CRM02: four separate gold accumulators disagree, which is an S15 coherence defect rather than a leak.

An aggro'd inf_trash at 2.5 m refuses the parley cold and YIELDS after learnTopic('the-drowned-ford') — a Morrowind topic learned outside the fight deciding, at 60 Hz, inside it, whether a hostile can be resolved without a corpse.
Imperial bounty 0 -> guard entity SUSPICIOUS on `sight`; bounty 3000 -> the same entity at alert 100 on channel `bounty`, band 3, weapon drawn. The crime ledger reaches into the fight.
The stealth step is not gated on combat state; guard-band transitions and witness derivation fire with a hostile body present.

Round 1's four orphans (V, the sound radius, the witness predicate, the search) are all now consumed; one model — plausibleSet() — is consumed but always returns the empty set, which is the same thing from the player's chair.

score.band_label: Skeleton — the models are now genuinely consumed by the world, and the enforcement they feed is a free win
score.note: The mean is dragged by RI-STL01's min-over-axes rule, whose minimum is the §9 bypass census — an axis that needs a province W1-01/W1-03/W1-12 own and that does not exist. The detection sub-axis of the same item measures 9. A reader who takes 3.0 as 'barely moved from 2' will be wrong about the round: the headline coupling went 0.00 -> 0.9986 and survives an independent instrument.

biggest_gap.what: The only guard in the build cannot attack and surrenders for nothing: guard_legion declares ai 'hold_ground' (combat/enemy.js only runs an action for ai === 'scripted', so an AGGRO guard held at 2.0 m for 900 frames deals 0 damage and never leaves REPOSITION) and its parley declares gold_price 0 against base_disposition 35, which makes combat/parley.js's GOLD ground unconditional — so one `interact` press yields a band-3 attack-on-sight guard at full HP for 0 gold and 0 stamina, leaving the imperial bounty at 3000 and jail null.
biggest_gap.why_it_matters: Everything else this piece built downstream of a crime — the 17-crime schedule, the derived witness, the five report routes, the three-band ladder, the three arrest answers, the jail ledger, S6 persistence — is correct, measured and reachable, and all of it is discarded by a single button press against an enemy that could not have hurt you anyway. From the player's chair crime has no consequence, which is the exact failure RI-CRM01 exists to prevent and the exact shape RI-MTH07 warns about one level up: the model is computed, consumed, and then thrown away by the interaction that resolves it. It also makes ARBITRATION S13's non-lethal exit meaningless as a design object — a parley that always succeeds is not a choice, and the round-1 finding that the guard ladder was 'a function of a number setBounty() wrote' is only half closed: the band is now real behaviour, and the behaviour is nothing.

remedy.action: In game/data/combat/enemies/guard_legion.json set parley.gold_price to a live figure (the current imperial bounty, or a fixed value >= 200 g) and raise the GOLD ground's disposition requirement for guards to 40 so a cold surrender fails; in game/src/combat/player.js::_resolveParley route an accepted surrender against a guard into engine.arrestTopics()/answerArrest() so the three answers fire and the bounty is paid, served or refused rather than left standing; and give guard_legion an AI that swings — ai 'scripted' with a scenario file today, W1-12's behaviour when it lands.

amendments_assessed.assessment: ACCEPT. The critic derived gamma = 1.36 independently from the item's own worked table before reading the amendment. Row 4's '(clamped)' annotation is false at the item's stated 0.7, which is decisive. This is a builder correcting the standard, not easing it: gamma > 1 makes darkness matter MORE, which is the harder direction.

amendments_assessed.id: AMENDMENT-W1-15-01 §5 — RI-AI01 §B vs RI-STL01 §2's base fill rate (100/s vs 75/s at 0.5R)
amendments_assessed.assessment: ACCEPT. The two items genuinely differ by a third at exactly the distance both work an example at. The build picks the one with an assertable method behind it and records the choice as data with the counterfactual stated ('set it the other way and RI-STL01 method 2's five rows fail instead'). That is the right way to surface an RI-MTH05 coherence defect. The corpus owner still has to pick.

ACCEPT IN PRINCIPLE, REJECT THE SUPPORTING TABLE. The reasoning is sound and does not lower a bar: the item annotates >= 22 as '~12% of ~180', and 22 of 33 would be 67% of every quest in the game, which breaches RI-QST05's spread cap it was written to respect. But the table quotes 13 sneak / 8 steal / VERB-SPREAD 24.7%, and at HEAD the figures are 7 / 5 / 27.3%. The amendment must be re-filed with the tree's actual numbers. Under the ratio reading 7/33 = 21.2% still clears 12%; under RI-QST05 §C's own per-verb minimum of 10 quests it does not.

amendments_assessed.id: AMENDMENT-W1-15-01 §7 — RI-STL01 method 6's two S-2 assertions contradict each other
amendments_assessed.assessment: ACCEPT. The arithmetic is checkable and correct: 4.0 s to the LKP + 2.0 s dwell + 9.0 s of cover volumes + 9.5 s out to 19 m is 24.5 s against a 12.0 s window at S17's 2.0 m/s. The band-as-reacquire-radius reading is also the reading §7's own prose supports ('a player who hides at 10 m and holds still is FOUND'). Note the irony the amendment does not: the S-1 leg it prices into the 24.5 s never actually runs, because plausibleSet() always returns [].

amendments_assessed.id: NEW, filed by this critic — RI-STL01 §4's sound table right-hand column
amendments_assessed.assessment: A THIRD arithmetic defect in the same item, filed by neither round. §4's LEFT column reproduces exactly from §4's own formula and constants (36.31 / 15.55 / 6.48 against 36.2 / 15.5 / 6.5). Its RIGHT column ('Sneak 100, light, mud') is a flat 0.393-0.400 of r_base while E_sound(light) x S_sound(100) x surface(mud) = 0.2625, giving 3.675 / 1.575 / 0.656 against the published 5.5 / 2.4 / 1.0. Either the table or one of the three constants is wrong. The build implements the formula.

corpus_extended.what: §4's sound table right-hand column is not reproducible from §4's own formula and constants. Filed as a new arithmetic defect alongside the amendment's §1 and §5.

A fourth shape of the failure, not in §A's table: the ORPHANED-BY-GEOMETRY model. plausibleSet() has a named consumer, is called every search, and returns the empty set every time because a precondition can never be satisfied. Coupling measured against its output is 1 and the behaviour still does not exist. §A's three shapes are all wiring failures; this one is a wiring success with a dead precondition, and only a probe that asserts the output is NON-EMPTY catches it.

Two more probe traps, both of which produced a false measurement in this critic's own first pass: setEntityPos() silently ignores opts.yaw while spawn() honours it, so every 'rear arc' measurement taken through setEntityPos is really taken at yaw 180; and queueInputs() frame numbers are RELATIVE to the current frame, so an absolute frame number silently never fires (this made the pickpocket read 0 draws and 0 caught).
